difficulty_reason: After standard vector-species/Hopf-monoid axioms and the Takeuchi expansion, the retained authored proof still proves each coefficient fiber has a unique minimum and interval-closed refinement structure, constructs its non-nesting forbidden-merge graph and sign-reversing involution, and recursively classifies fixed-point edge chains. The even and odd backward reconstruction proves at most one fixed point of each parity; decomposition and short-edge factorization extend the signed coefficient bound to every fiber. These fiber and graph involutions are not assumed as ordinary Hopf facts.
